comparison.objective: Raise two unstable arch halves simultaneously so they support each other; candidate adjusts an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronous dual-object placement and simultaneous release versus fine tool insertion, rotary tuning, counterholding, tightening, and repeated testing.
comparison.success_condition: Both halves stand mutually supported on marks with grippers released; body omits mark and stability tolerances. Candidate has quantified dynamic and retention conditions.
comparison.reason: Cooperative structure assembly does not test commissioning or force-response tuning.
